# [Baseline] - IOS - U - Compliance Password

Checks whether an iPhone or iPad requires a passcode of at least six characters, no simple code, and locks after fifteen minutes.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | iOS/iPadOS |
| Scope | User (U) — assign to user groups |
| Type | Compliance |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline convention for compliance; values aligned with the six-character PIN requirement in the existing App Protection policy. |
| File | [`Baseline_IOS_U_Compliance_Password.json`](Baseline_IOS_U_Compliance_Password.json) |

> Deliberately no `passcodeExpirationDays`: forcing periodic changes of a device passcode demonstrably leads to weaker passcodes, and NIST SP 800-63B explicitly advises against mandatory rotation without cause. Fifteen minutes is aligned with the macOS and Windows compliance policies in the baseline.
